project.name: Pathland View Processor
project.description: JSR 269 annotation processor for com.pathland.view.state.State fields. Generates a <View>_StateBinder per view class that wires each State field to the session's PersistentState (auto-keyed by field name, recursing into nested view fields). Framework-agnostic — used by Quarkus, Spring Boot, and desktop.
